candidates.change_summary: Return bytes32(0) instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT in proxiableUUID.
Remove the entire body of notDelegated, making it a no-op, so proxiableUUID no longer reverts on delegatecall.
Delete the line `$._initialized = 1;` so the initialization flag is never set.
Replace `$._initialized = 1;` with `$._initialized = 2;` so the initialized version is 2 instead of 1.
Delete the revert inside `initialSetup` check so initialization can proceed even if already initialized.
Delete the `IsTopLevelCall` block that sets `_initializing` to true, so the flag never signals active initialization.
Delete `__Access_init(_accessControl);` so the access control is never set.
Delete `__UUPSUpgradeable_init();` so UUPS initialization is skipped.
Remove the `initializer` modifier so the function can be called without initialization guards.
Replace `initializer` modifier with `reinitializer(2)` so it requires version 2 but sets version to 2.
Swap the two internal init calls so UUPS inits before Access.
Replace elapsed = block.timestamp - utilizationData.lastUpdate with elapsed = block.timestamp - utilizationData.lastUpdate + 1
Replace utilization = (index - utilizationData.index) / elapsed with utilization = (index - utilizationData.index) * 1e18 / elapsed
Delete the else branch and always compute utilization as (index - utilizationData.index) / elapsed
Replace utilizationData.lastUpdate = block.timestamp with utilizationData.lastUpdate = block.timestamp - 1
Replace utilizationData.index = index with utilizationData.index = index + 1
